author: Forbes
description:
Unapologetic Foods founder and CEO Roni Mazumdar has taken the New York City restaurant scene by storm with smash-hit establishments like Adda, Dhamaka, and Semma. But long before the Michelin stars and lines around the block, Mazumdar faced immense challenges. In this episode of The One Who Changed Everything, Mazumdar sits down with Forbes’ Maggie McGrath to share how a fateful meeting with an unconventional investor, Dr. Mukul Arya, gave him the courage to survive early failures, fight systemic biases, and build a culinary empire that unapologetically celebrates authentic regional cuisines.

author: Forbes
description:
In 2025, when AI startup Spellbook signed a long-term deal with Anthropic to use its models to review legal contracts, CEO Scott Stevenson wasn’t worried about the AI giant coming for his lunch. Anthropic staffers told him explicitly they didn’t see the firm directly competing with Spellbook in the legal space, he recalls.

A year later, he was caught off guard when Anthropic informed him that it was launching Claude for Legal. The tool, tailored for law firms, has dozens of capabilities ranging from contract review to citation checking to tracking regulatory changes — many of which overlap with Spellbook. That made things, “a little bit awkward,” Stenvenson says. He decided to be more cautious sharing data and product roadmaps with the AI giant.

title: Inside Silicon Valley’s Love-Hate Relationship With Anthropic
